name: Crashed Maintenance Ship
description: The opening Survival landmark contains the crashed ship, the three-fire Getting Started objective, the nearby Water Bucket pond, the first Master Battery ruin, the Mini Craftbot, and the Logbook route to the Mechanic Station.
navigation: From the ship entrance, follow the path in the opposite direction to reach the pond and farming tutorial. After extinguishing the marked ship fires, follow the active objective and crash-debris trail to the nearby Master Battery ruin.
preparation: Fill the Water Bucket and extinguish all 3 marked fires inside the ship.
Recover the nearby Master Battery and install it in the crashed ship, not the Mechanic Station.
Craft the Connect Tool, finish the console objective, and open the Logbook.
Leave only after the Mechanic Station waypoint appears; farming and Your First Car can then be handled as separate branches.

name: Mechanic Station
description: A recognizable station marked by a large illuminated wrench, commonly used as an early workshop, storage point, and vehicle base.
navigation: Follow connected roads and watch the skyline for the wrench sign. Record the junction used to reach it, not only the final building.
preparation: Bring the key progression item requested by the station objective.
Clear nearby threats before moving storage into the building.
Keep the first vehicle simple enough to repair on site.

name: Packing Station
description: A road-side destination used in produce logistics. Its value comes from turning farming into a transport problem rather than a chest-management problem.
navigation: Treat the road between the farm and station as a freight route. Test bridge clearance, slopes, and turning space before hauling a full load.
preparation: Use a low cargo deck with secure load boundaries.
Carry fuel and a recovery Lift.
Clear roadside bots before driving a slow, heavy load.

name: Farmers Hideout
description: A progression and trading location where prepared deliveries become useful equipment. The route matters as much as the destination because cargo can be bulky.
navigation: Use the road network around a Packing Station and watch for the hideout's large industrial silhouette and smokestack.
preparation: Confirm the delivery you are pursuing before loading the vehicle.
Leave room to carry the reward home safely.
Avoid mixing important cargo with loose exploration loot.
relatedLabel: Open the packing and trading route

name: Warehouse
description: A large multi-level combat and exploration landmark associated with ranged bot threats, valuable materials, and difficult recovery runs.
navigation: Park outside the immediate approach, mark the entrance used, and keep the return vehicle facing away from the structure.
preparation: Bring a ranged weapon with a deliberate ammunition reserve.
Carry food, light, and only the tools needed for the run.
Deposit unrelated valuables before entering.
Clear rooms methodically instead of chasing enemies across floors.

name: Growlabs
description: Growlabs are part of the expanded 1.0 Survival world and story. They combine exploration, combat, and progression in spaces where preparation matters.
navigation: Follow the active objective and build a reversible route from the nearest safe storage point. Exact placement varies with the generated world.
preparation: Read the objective before crossing the final approach.
Bring ranged protection, food, light, and spare ammunition.
Test the route with low-value inventory first.
Back out and resupply instead of turning the run into an unrecoverable loss.

name: Excavation Island
description: A new 1.0 region built around abandoned mines, underground digging, rare discoveries, and machine-led excavation.
navigation: Plan the trip as a separate expedition. Keep a surface staging point and make underground turns readable with sparse, consistent markers.
preparation: Separate mining equipment from the road vehicle when possible.
Carry lighting, food, and storage capacity.
Leave a clear return corridor for a loaded mining machine.
Expect terrain shaping and drilling to change the route behind you.

name: Desert Biome
description: A reworked 1.0 biome with open sightlines, different travel demands, and weather hazards that can interrupt vehicle routes.
navigation: Favor visible roads and landmark bearings over cutting across unmarked flats. Note fuel needs before a long desert crossing.
preparation: Carry extra fuel and food for long reverse trips.
Watch for tornado warnings and give storms a wide berth.
Do not test fragile suspension builds as the only desert scout.

name: Tornado Weather Hazard
description: 1.0 weather events that can appear in desert and open areas. Official notes suggest avoiding them; community builds often try to drive through anyway.
navigation: If a tornado forms on your route, divert early using a road junction rather than racing the funnel with a loaded cargo truck.
preparation: Keep valuable cargo off experimental storm-chasing vehicles.
Have a reverse landmark ready if visibility collapses.
Prefer postponing a packing delivery over losing the whole haul.

name: Scrap City Garage
description: A 1.0 Garage destination used to bring supported Creative and Survival creations into an active Survival world.
navigation: Locate Scrap City through story and road progression, then treat the Garage as a transfer stop rather than a combat objective.
preparation: Start with a small unmodded blueprint before loading a complex Workshop creation.
Use the 30-slot Garage Chest and sort supplies by the exact material bill.
Remove unavailable or version-specific parts before the first Survival assembly.

name: Ruins and Ruin City
description: Ruins range from small roadside loot stops to dense areas with multiple approach angles and stronger threats.
navigation: Use the road-facing side as the return reference and clear a small perimeter before entering tight spaces.
preparation: Keep one empty inventory row for recovered materials.
Listen for bots before climbing into blind corners.
Return loot to the vehicle before pushing into the next structure.

name: Chemical Lake
description: A hazardous-looking resource landmark that is useful to identify when planning chemical collection and nearby travel routes.
navigation: Mark the safe road approach rather than driving directly toward the shoreline with a heavy vehicle.
preparation: Bring the container or collection build needed for the trip.
Keep important vehicle controls away from exposed edges.
Plan how the collected material will be stored at base.

name: Silo District
description: A large industrial area that can expose vehicles and players to dangerous bot encounters across open approaches.
navigation: Scout the outer road first, choose a retreat line, and avoid parking valuable transport in the center of the approach.
preparation: Use a disposable scout vehicle or travel light.
Keep a ranged escape option.
Do not let the only storage vehicle become the combat cover.

name: Farmer Shacks and Camps
description: Small structures and camps are useful resupply stops, route markers, and sources of ordinary building material during exploration.
navigation: Use them as named stops between major landmarks. One clear marker at a nearby road junction is more useful than marking every shack.
preparation: Check the perimeter before looting indoors.
Take only what supports the current objective.
Leave enough vehicle capacity for higher-value discoveries.

name: Farmbot Scrapyard
description: A location where the environment itself warns that heavy hostile machinery may be nearby.
navigation: Approach from open ground with a clear exit. Dense cover can hide large enemies and trap a wide vehicle.
preparation: Leave fragile transport outside the threat area.
Carry enough ammunition to disengage safely.
Avoid fighting with valuable cargo already loaded.
